evals.prompt: The PR is open. A reviewer says the export drops rows with a null date, and another says a helper should be renamed for no stated reason. CI is green.
evals.expected_output: Each comment examined against the code, the valid one proven and fixed as a follow-up commit, and replies drafted with their proof for approval.
expectations: Examines each comment against the code before changing anything
Proves the null-date claim with a failing test or other evidence before fixing it
Shows the fix with that check passing and the usual checks run, then commits and pushes it as a follow-up
Gives evidence for leaving the rename, or for making it, instead of complying unexamined
Drafts reviewer replies with their proof and posts none without approval of the exact text

evals.prompt: CI on the open PR just failed in the static analysis job.
evals.expected_output: The failure reproduced locally, fixed, rerun to green and pushed as a follow-up, without asking first.
expectations: Reproduces the failure locally with the failing command
Fixes it and reruns until it passes, without asking the user first
Runs the usual change-scoped checks before committing
Pushes the fix as a follow-up commit and gives a one-line status

evals.prompt: The PR now conflicts with main after another merge.
evals.expected_output: Main merged into the branch and the conflict resolved, with published commits left as they are.
expectations: Merges the target into the branch instead of rebasing published commits
Runs the checks covering the resolved files before pushing

evals.prompt: Open the approved PR as Ready for review. Then, on the other Draft PR, mention the review bot so it reviews.
evals.expected_output: watch-pr started on both PRs straight away, without being asked.
expectations: Starts watching the Ready PR right after opening it
Starts watching the Draft PR right after the review request
Does not ask whether to watch either PR

evals.prompt: Keep an eye on PR 99 until it is merged.
evals.expected_output: A wait on the PR's events with one status line per check, ending in a short report when the PR merges or closes.
expectations: Waits on PR events instead of polling on a short timer
Gives one status line per check
Stops and reports what changed once the PR merges or closes
